title: Node reordering does not work properly when the parent is a complex instanced scene
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.6.dev4

### System information

Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.7076) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1135G7 @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.80 GiB memory

### Issue description

If the  parent node is a scene composed with more than two nodes, reordering newly added children does not work as expected.

This affects both drag-and-drop and keyboard shortcuts.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6d349e71-8e17-4016-94ba-655d027689c3

The issue is not 100% reproducible. It can appears and disappears depending on editor state.
It may start working or fail again after performing actions such as:
- Reopening the project
- Modifying the parent scene (add more nodes)
- Switching between drag-and-drop and keyboard shortcuts

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new scene with 3 or more child nodes
2. Save it
3. Instantiate this scene inside another scene
4. Add several new child nodes under the instanced scene
5. Try to reorder one of these newly added children

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[node-reordering-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23687223/node-reordering-bug.zip)
